title: gift wrap organizer
text: gift wrap organizer. This works perfectly to store your xmas wrap with a zippered top.  It has handles on the top lid portion and the middle, side. Super handy to lift and move about.  I have 9 rolls in it with a bit of room to spare and they are pretty full rolls.  The clear plastic is pretty thin... so I wouldn't place it near sharp or other pointed edges.  Also, the rolls I am storing are regular length... not the extra long ones.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  To be honest, I am considering purchasing a second one to place non-xmas rolls in.
